name: ai-live-translator
description: A bilingual text interpreter for AI agents. Translate ordinary user messages without answering them; use explicit direct address for agent commands.

interface.shortDescription: Translate messages between two languages without answering them.
interface.longDescription: Activate a two-way text interpreter, choose any two languages, and get only natural translations of ordinary messages. Explicit direct address lets you control the agent, pause, or change languages. No external account, API, or microphone access is required. With voice transcripts, distinguish the user's intended speech from background voices and ask for clarification when speakers are unclear.
defaultPrompt: Start AI Live Translator and ask me which two languages to use.
ابدأ المترجم الحي واسألني عن اللغتين.
